gloss: livability; comfort of living; how comfortable a place is to live in

definitions.gloss: comfort of living; livability; how comfortable a place feels to live in
definitions.explanation: the subjective feeling of how pleasant, convenient, or comfortable a home or area is to live in

examples.english: This house is comfortable to live in.

examples.japanese: {住|す}み{心地|ごこち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a comfortable neighborhood to live in.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、{住|す}み{心地|ごこち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悪|わる}くない→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: This room is small, but it's not bad to live in.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ (to live, reside) + {心地|ごこち} (feeling, comfort) → feeling of living

THE ～{心地|ごこち} PATTERN:
This suffix creates nouns describing how something feels:
- ⟦{座|すわ}り{心地|ごこち}→座り心地：10669_suwarigokochi⟧ (seating comfort)
- ⟦{着|き}{心地|ごこち}→着心地：07269_kigokochi⟧ (wearing comfort)
- ⟦{寝|ね}{心地|ごこち}→寝心地：07270_negokochi⟧ (sleeping comfort)
- ⟦{乗|の}り{心地|ごこち}→乗り心地：07268_norigokochi⟧ (ride comfort)
- ⟦{書|か}き{心地|ごこち}→書き心地：08717_kakigokochi⟧ (writing feel)
- {履|は}き{心地|ごこち} (wearing comfort - footwear)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {住|す}み{心地|ごこち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/よい (comfortable to live in)
- {住|す}み{心地|ごこち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (uncomfortable to live in)
- {住|す}み{心地|ごこち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧ (a comfortable home)

FACTORS AFFECTING {住|す}み{心地|ごこち}:
- ⟦{日当|ひあ}たり→日当たり：07498_hiatari⟧ (sunlight)
- ⟦{風通|かぜとお}し→風通し：09032_kazetooshi⟧ (ventilation)
- ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧さ (quietness)
- ⟦{利便性|りべんせい}→利便性：10681_ribensei⟧ (convenience)
